findings.source_passage: I am part of that, a little solemn with the feel of those long winters, a little complacent from growing up in the Carraway house
findings.source_locator: Middle-West reminiscence, 3rd paragraph after Union Station scene
findings.why_it_matters: Nick’s self-definition and ironic distance are carried in this single, rhythmically balanced sentence; cutting it hollows the regional thesis and flattens voice.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the full sentence immediately after the ‘That’s my Middle West’ line.

findings.source_passage: “Are you a college man? … a ‘gonnegtion,’ but he only nodded and shook my hand.”
findings.source_locator: Wolfshiem office scene, just before Nick exits
findings.why_it_matters: Wolfshiem’s quirky diction (‘gonnegtion’) is a miniature classic; critics quote it when discussing Fitzgerald’s ethnic caricature and Gatsby’s underworld ties. Its removal deletes a culturally noted tic.
findings.suggested_fix: Insert the exchange verbatim, including the stage-direction about the two fingers and Nick’s aside about a ‘gonnegtion’.

findings.source_passage: Even when the East excited me most, even when I was most keenly aware of its superiority to the bored, sprawling, swollen towns beyond the Ohio …
findings.source_locator: Paragraph following ‘I see now that this has been a story of the West’
findings.why_it_matters: The piling modifiers (‘bored, sprawling, swollen’) and the parenthetical clause are textbook Fitzgerald cadence; truncation saps the prosody and thematic contrast between regions.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the full clause from ‘even when I was most keenly aware…’ through ‘spared only the children and the very old’ before resuming the existing sentence.

summary: Three mid-level signature/voice cuts (‘I am part of that…’; Wolfshiem’s ‘gonnegtion’; and the full East-vs-West sentence) push the draft below preservation standard.
